title_en: Which Department Does This Work Belong To?
deck_zh: 分工能让知识走深，也会留下格子之间的空白。跨过墙不是取消标准，而是让两套标准都不能独自替整件事作答。
deck_en: Specialization gives knowledge depth and leaves gaps between its boxes. Crossing a boundary need not abolish standards. It means neither set can answer the whole question alone.
body_zh: 设想一篇经济史论文送来。历史学者问档案怎样取得、当时的话怎样读；经济学者问因果识别能不能成立。双方都认真，也都不是无理取闹。麻烦在于，一方觉得足够的证据，另一方仍觉得不能承担那种结论。
如果只问归哪个系，事情似乎简单得多。放进一个系，就照这个系的办法评。可是，那篇论文并没有因为找到一个办公地址，就失去另一半的问题。行政上可以有归口，学术上不应因此已经作完判断。
学科与系，首先不是同一样东西。同行散在许多大学，期刊、学会、训练和共同语言把他们连起来。一所大学的系，则同时牵着预算、聘任、评价与学位。跨校的知识网络，与校内分配事务的单位，不能压成一张地图。
分工本身没有错。不必每个人重新发明全部方法，专业工作才可能钻得深。这篇不要求撤系，也不宣布学科边界大多压住了创新。它问的是更具体的一处：大学作了划分，划分以外的工作由谁说明？
亚利桑那州立大学一份注明2008年日期的联合聘任指南，把一个人同时属于几个单位时的责任写下来：终身教职归属单位之外的参与单位提供相应工作部分的评价意见，备忘录约定年度工作计划与薪酬等分担；有关单位可以共同发展跨学科评价准则。
它给出的不是一套已经解决所有跨学科争议的统一标准。“可以拟定”，也不是“必须已经有”。它只是让人看见，谁提供意见，怎样分工作与钱，可以先有成文的着落，而不把一个人夹在两份全职期待之间。
现实执行到哪里，还需要另查。指南存在，不证明每次聘任照它进行；工作有归口，也不证明评价标准已足够。每份材料证到哪里就停在哪里，恰好也是研究交界处需要的习惯。
没有现成的系愿意接，并不自动证明大学封闭。可能是问题尚待澄清，可能真的缺乏能力或资源。墙出现于另一种动作：既有格子被当作装下了一切，凡放不进去的便不再需要受理、解释、转介与复核。
所以，划分留下的缝，需要作划分的一方回答。不是要求每个申请最后都得到批准，而是不让没有归属本身，成为一个无需再解释的终点。拒绝可以成立，拒绝的根据仍应清楚，也要有地方追问。
若要给某一次封闭作完整判断，仍需查清具体前提、排除的理由、是否有别处真能承接，以及有限审查有没有被用来把未处理问题结案。单凭“这个系不收”，不能把整条证据链替它补齐。
华盛顿大学的个人跨学科博士，为一类单个现有博士单位无法满足的研究目标，提供跨项目指导的路径。它同时写有很高的学业条件。这既是一条路，也是一道有自己门槛的路；门槛并不因名叫跨学科就免于询问。
一个特别项目的存在，不能替所有在交界处工作的人作保。它也没有答应任何题目都有钱、任何人都能进去。但它足以让一个问题不再只能以“没有这个系”结束：没有现成归属的工作，至少可能被设计成可接收的对象。
更早的思想分歧，也留下过相近的入口。蔡元培1919年答林纾的信，以理由和根据，而不是所属学派，说明容许不同学说发展的门槛。这里借的是这个结构，不把学派说成系，也不凭一封信认证实际聘任始终如此。
这样的公开话语，可以成为后来追问的根据：既然门槛落在论证上，为什么这一回只问归属？但一条可以援引的话，与一套真能约束掌权者的安排，仍然不是同一件事。历史例子也不能跳过这个差别。
于是，跨学科的工作至少会碰到四道具体问题：谁评，标准怎样相接，成果记在哪里，钱从哪里来。前两道不说明，评价就容易变成谁声音大；后两道不说明，原本赞同合作的人也会在日常运行里彼此拉扯。
联合聘任的备忘录是一种做法，不是唯一办法。两处怎样分担工作，另一单位怎样提供意见，需要说清。一个人不可能同时把两边会议和服务都完整参加；不能名义上各分一半，实际上却要他完成两份全部。
还有不能靠备忘录名称解决的一道：标准是否真的相接。若所有工作最后仍须先变成原来格子认可的东西，跨学科流程也可能只是给旧分类换个入口。允许提交，与允许问题改变怎样评价它，是不同强度。
组织重组也不是最后答案。把几个系并进一个新学院，墙可能移动，也可能在新名字下面重新出现。一个新单位也会划分，会留下自己收不进来的问题；不能因为成立的口号是打破边界，就从此不必再说明边界。
这些不是宣称重组通常失败。发生率、实际效果和哪一种划分更好，都需要自己的研究。这里不拿一种可能机制，替全世界大学的经验调查作结论；它只是要求新旧单位接受同样的追问。
回到那篇经济史论文。争议不是两边都没有标准，而是两套标准都在。档案的厚度与模型的识别，各有要保护的东西。把其中一套赶走会失去什么，把它直接加上去又会压掉什么，需要有人在这篇工作上判断。
这正可以是学习的地方。两位老师各讲半门课，学生可能只拿到两套并排的规矩；若把各自为什么这样要求说出来，让学生面对同一项工作去说明取舍，规则之间的张力才可能成为练判断的材料。
形式本身不保证结果。两位导师也可能只是轮流要求服从，跨系课程也可能各讲各的。能安排的是相遇的条件，发生没发生自己的判断，仍要回到具体工作看。不能一见联合二字，就把成长填进成果栏。
有人担心，既然没有一套共同标准，最后总是职位高的人说了算。这个担心不该被安慰掉。但回答不是把职位重新伪装成标准，而是让取舍的根据可见、可问；谁作了决定，谁就不能只指着自己的座位。
发问的位置，也不必包给某一个学院。哲学可以提出重要问题，不因此取得替所有学科终审的特权。把问题从旧墙缝里接出来，不是再交给一堵自认高于其余人的新墙。
门口与门里要分别保留。门口，不仅因为没有现成归属就退回；门里，归口即使在某个系，也不让它的一套既有标准独自包办整项工作。资源能否给，结论能否成立，各有根据，不由开放的口号预先保证。
一篇夹在两套标准之间的论文，不必获得特别宽容，也不应被轻易放过。它需要的，可能只是一个能认真面对它实际难处的位置：不先把它削成格子的形状，再宣布削去的那一半，从来不是一个问题。
body_en: Imagine an economic-history paper under review. A historian asks how the archive was assembled and its language interpreted. An economist asks whether causal identification holds. Both can be careful and reasonable while disagreeing about what the material can support. The difficulty is not disposed of by choosing the more familiar vocabulary.

An administrative question looks easier: which department owns the submission? Assign it there and use that department's criteria. But a mailing address cannot remove half the intellectual problem. Work can have a receiving unit without that unit's existing rules having already judged everything the work attempts.

A discipline and a department are different arrangements. Peers, journals, societies, training, and common languages connect people across universities. A department within one university also organizes budgets, appointments, assessment, and degrees. A knowledge network and an administrative allocation of responsibilities cannot be collapsed into the same map.

Specialization is not the mistake. People can go further because they need not reinvent every method. The argument neither abolishes departments nor claims that boundaries usually suppress discovery. It asks a narrower question: who answers for work left between divisions that the university itself maintains?

An Arizona State joint-appointment guideline dated 2008 specifies contributions from a unit other than the tenure home and agreements about work plans, salary sharing, and related responsibilities. Units may develop interdisciplinary evaluation guidelines together. It offers a concrete example of assigning work before assuming that one person can satisfy every expectation at once.

May develop does not mean already supplied or must exist. The document does not settle all cross-disciplinary standards. Its limited lesson is that who comments, how work is assigned, and how costs are shared can acquire a written address instead of being left as an individual's private negotiation between incompatible demands.

Implementation requires another inquiry. An existing guideline cannot establish compliance in every appointment, and a designated home cannot certify adequate criteria. Letting each document establish only its own scope is itself a useful habit at disciplinary boundaries. Administrative specificity helps without becoming evidence of every desired outcome.

No ready department willing to receive a proposal does not automatically establish closure. A question may need clarification, or expertise and money may be unavailable. A wall appears when existing boxes are treated as exhaustive, so work outside them no longer requires reception, explanation, referral, or reconsideration.

The institution drawing the divisions should answer for the gap they produce. This does not promise acceptance of every application. It prevents absence of affiliation from becoming an unexplained endpoint. Rejection can be justified while its reasons remain available and open to challenge. A route matters without predetermining its destination.

A complete diagnosis of closure still needs evidence: the premise used, the exclusion, effective reception elsewhere, and whether a limited review was used to close something it never addressed. One departmental refusal cannot supply the entire chain. A concern becomes stronger through records, not by quietly replacing them.

Washington's Individual Interdisciplinary PhD offers a route for research aims not met within one authorized doctoral unit, with supervision across programs. It also states demanding academic eligibility conditions. It is both a route and a threshold. Calling it interdisciplinary does not exempt that threshold or its application from questions.

One exceptional program cannot guarantee conditions for everyone at a boundary. Nor does it promise funds for every topic. It nevertheless makes an institutional possibility visible: work without a ready departmental home can become receivable, rather than automatically being treated as something the university cannot recognize at all.

An earlier dispute leaves a related contrast. Cai Yuanpei's 1919 reply to Lin Shu describes room for opposing schools of thought on grounds of reasons and evidence, rather than allegiance alone. Schools of thought are not departments. The comparison concerns where a threshold is placed, not equivalence of institutions or historical situations.

Such a public statement can give later people grounds to ask why affiliation rather than argument decided a case. It does not establish faithful implementation across appointments. A usable statement and an arrangement able to constrain its issuer remain different things. Historical admiration should not merge them into one certificate.

Four questions consequently need practical addresses: who reviews, how criteria meet, where work is recorded, and where funds come from. Missing the first pair can leave authority to the loudest voice; missing the second can make people who genuinely support collaboration pull against each other in ordinary operation.

A joint-appointment memorandum is one possible response, not the only one. Workload and the second unit's input need specification. A person cannot fully attend both sets of meetings and perform two complete service loads. Two nominal halves should not quietly become two actual wholes expected from one individual.

A document's existence also cannot settle whether criteria meet. If every submission must ultimately become an example the old categories already recognize, a new interdisciplinary procedure may only provide another entrance into the same restriction. Receiving a question differs from permitting its difficulty to affect how it is evaluated.

Reorganization is no final answer either. Merging departments can move a wall or recreate one under a new name. A new school draws divisions too and leaves things outside. Its founding language about overcoming boundaries cannot remove its responsibility for the boundaries it subsequently makes and maintains.

This is not a claim that restructuring generally fails. Frequency, effects, and comparative institutional designs need their own research. A possible mechanism cannot substitute for a survey of universities. The demand is only that new units remain answerable by the same conditions as their predecessors.

Return to the economic-history paper. The problem is not an absence of standards; it is their simultaneous presence. Archival interpretation and model identification protect different things. What is lost by excluding either, and what is obscured by simply adding it, require judgment about this particular work rather than allegiance to a label.

That difficulty can become a place to learn. Two instructors each teaching half a course may deliver two adjacent rulebooks. Explaining why the rules ask different things, then requiring students to account for a choice about the same work, can instead make the tension material for exercising judgment.

The format guarantees neither outcome. Two advisers can demand alternating obedience; a joint course can remain two unconnected lectures. An institution arranges conditions for an encounter, not the encounter's personal result. Whether judgment occurred still needs the work examined. The word joint cannot fill in an achievement by itself.

A serious objection remains: without a shared standard, won't the higher office decide? Reassurance is not enough. The response is to make reasons for a choice visible and questionable, not to disguise office as a standard. Whoever decides must do more than point to the chair they occupy.

The questioning function need not be reserved for one faculty. Philosophy can ask important questions without becoming final judge over all disciplines. Receiving work from between old walls should not mean handing it to a new wall that considers itself superior to every other intellectual practice.

Keep both entrance and interior in view. Work should not be returned solely for lacking a ready home. Once housed, it should not be wholly decided by that unit's familiar criteria. Whether resources are available and a conclusion holds remain separate questions with grounds an open-door slogan cannot supply.

A paper between standards needs neither special indulgence nor easy acceptance. It needs an address able to face its actual difficulty. First cutting it down to fit a box, then declaring the removed half never a question, would make organizational tidiness stand in for the judgment the university still owes.

body_hant: 設想一篇經濟史論文送來。歷史學者問檔案怎樣取得、當時的話怎樣讀；經濟學者問因果識別能不能成立。雙方都認真，也都不是無理取鬧。麻煩在於，一方覺得足夠的證據，另一方仍覺得不能承擔那種結論。
如果只問歸哪個系，事情似乎簡單得多。放進一個系，就照這個系的辦法評。可是，那篇論文並沒有因為找到一個辦公地址，就失去另一半的問題。行政上可以有歸口，學術上不應因此已經作完判斷。
學科與系，首先不是同一樣東西。同行散在許多大學，期刊、學會、訓練和共同語言把他們連起來。一所大學的系，則同時牽著預算、聘任、評價與學位。跨校的知識網路，與校內分配事務的單位，不能壓成一張地圖。
分工本身沒有錯。不必每個人重新發明全部方法，專業工作才可能鑽得深。這篇不要求撤系，也不宣佈學科邊界大多壓住了創新。它問的是更具體的一處：大學作了劃分，劃分以外的工作由誰說明？
亞利桑那州立大學一份註明2008年日期的聯合聘任指南，把一個人同時屬於幾個單位時的責任寫下來：終身教職歸屬單位之外的參與單位提供相應工作部分的評價意見，備忘錄約定年度工作計劃與薪酬等分擔；有關單位可以共同發展跨學科評價準則。
它給出的不是一套已經解決所有跨學科爭議的統一標準。「可以擬定」，也不是「必須已經有」。它只是讓人看見，誰提供意見，怎樣分工作與錢，可以先有成文的著落，而不把一個人夾在兩份全職期待之間。
現實執行到哪裡，還需要另查。指南存在，不證明每次聘任照它進行；工作有歸口，也不證明評價標準已足夠。每份材料證到哪裡就停在哪裡，恰好也是研究交界處需要的習慣。
沒有現成的系願意接，並不自動證明大學封閉。可能是問題尚待澄清，可能真的缺乏能力或資源。牆出現於另一種動作：既有格子被當作裝下了一切，凡放不進去的便不再需要受理、解釋、轉介與複核。
所以，劃分留下的縫，需要作劃分的一方回答。不是要求每個申請最後都得到批准，而是不讓沒有歸屬本身，成為一個無需再解釋的終點。拒絕可以成立，拒絕的根據仍應清楚，也要有地方追問。
若要給某一次封閉作完整判斷，仍需查清具體前提、排除的理由、是否有別處真能承接，以及有限審查有沒有被用來把未處理問題結案。單憑「這個系不收」，不能把整條證據鏈替它補齊。
華盛頓大學的個人跨學科博士，為一類單個現有博士單位無法滿足的研究目標，提供跨項目指導的路徑。它同時寫有很高的學業條件。這既是一條路，也是一道有自己門檻的路；門檻並不因名叫跨學科就免於詢問。
一個特別項目的存在，不能替所有在交界處工作的人作保。它也沒有答應任何題目都有錢、任何人都能進去。但它足以讓一個問題不再只能以「沒有這個系」結束：沒有現成歸屬的工作，至少可能被設計成可接收的對象。
更早的思想分歧，也留下過相近的入口。蔡元培1919年答林紓的信，以理由和根據，而不是所屬學派，說明容許不同學說發展的門檻。這裡借的是這個結構，不把學派說成系，也不憑一封信認證實際聘任始終如此。
這樣的公開話語，可以成為後來追問的根據：既然門檻落在論證上，為什麼這一回只問歸屬？但一條可以援引的話，與一套真能約束掌權者的安排，仍然不是同一件事。歷史例子也不能跳過這個差別。
於是，跨學科的工作至少會碰到四道具體問題：誰評，標準怎樣相接，成果記在哪裡，錢從哪裡來。前兩道不說明，評價就容易變成誰聲音大；後兩道不說明，原本贊同合作的人也會在日常運行裡彼此拉扯。
聯合聘任的備忘錄是一種做法，不是唯一辦法。兩處怎樣分擔工作，另一單位怎樣提供意見，需要說清。一個人不可能同時把兩邊會議和服務都完整參加；不能名義上各分一半，實際上卻要他完成兩份全部。
還有不能靠備忘錄名稱解決的一道：標準是否真的相接。若所有工作最後仍須先變成原來格子認可的東西，跨學科流程也可能只是給舊分類換個入口。允許提交，與允許問題改變怎樣評價它，是不同強度。
組織重組也不是最後答案。把幾個系並進一個新學院，牆可能移動，也可能在新名字下面重新出現。一個新單位也會劃分，會留下自己收不進來的問題；不能因為成立的口號是打破邊界，就從此不必再說明邊界。
這些不是宣稱重組通常失敗。發生率、實際效果和哪一種劃分更好，都需要自己的研究。這裡不拿一種可能機制，替全世界大學的經驗調查作結論；它只是要求新舊單位接受同樣的追問。
回到那篇經濟史論文。爭議不是兩邊都沒有標準，而是兩套標準都在。檔案的厚度與模型的識別，各有要保護的東西。把其中一套趕走會失去什麼，把它直接加上去又會壓掉什麼，需要有人在這篇工作上判斷。
這正可以是學習的地方。兩位老師各講半門課，學生可能只拿到兩套並排的規矩；若把各自為什麼這樣要求說出來，讓學生面對同一項工作去說明取捨，規則之間的張力才可能成為練判斷的材料。
形式本身不保證結果。兩位導師也可能只是輪流要求服從，跨系課程也可能各講各的。能安排的是相遇的條件，發生沒發生自己的判斷，仍要回到具體工作看。不能一見聯合二字，就把成長填進成果欄。
有人擔心，既然沒有一套共同標準，最後總是職位高的人說了算。這個擔心不該被安慰掉。但回答不是把職位重新偽裝成標準，而是讓取捨的根據可見、可問；誰作了決定，誰就不能只指著自己的座位。
發問的位置，也不必包給某一個學院。哲學可以提出重要問題，不因此取得替所有學科終審的特權。把問題從舊牆縫裡接出來，不是再交給一堵自認高於其餘人的新牆。
門口與門裡要分別保留。門口，不僅因為沒有現成歸屬就退回；門裡，歸口即使在某個系，也不讓它的一套既有標準獨自包辦整項工作。資源能否給，結論能否成立，各有根據，不由開放的口號預先保證。
一篇夾在兩套標準之間的論文，不必獲得特別寬容，也不應被輕易放過。它需要的，可能只是一個能認真面對它實際難處的位置：不先把它削成格子的形狀，再宣佈削去的那一半，從來不是一個問題。
